scope: Synthetic dyadic weights from sparse-attention-reference.json recipe, row 0 (no padding); upstream selections from the unchanged indexer via an appending cache port; float64 truth and first-order F32 bounds (A + B * eps, eps = cos/sin table absolute error). No learned weights.
boundDerivation: RMSNorm (1 + w): propagated |1+w| r (e_i + |x_i| sum|x||e| / sum x^2) plus 0.5(gamma_{n+1} + 2u) + 5u relative rounding.
Block pooling: sum of raw-key errors / ratio plus gamma_{ratio+1} sum|x| / ratio.
RoPE: |c| e_p + |s| e_q + 2u(|p c| + |q s|) + u|out| + eps(|p| + |q|) for table error eps.
Scores: gamma_128 |q||k| + |e_q||k| + |q||e_k| per head; relu Lipschitz 1; head sum gamma_{heads+1}; division u|s|.
